cohort: A total of 225 women, including 41 with Chronic Pelvic Pain Syndrome (defined as >= 6 months of lower abdominal pain) and 184 control patients undergoing routine gynecological screening, were evaluated in a gynecological pain clinic.
finding: The study found significant associations between CPPS and prior pelvic surgery, bowel constipation, history of endometriosis, and prior trauma, while finding no associations with several commonly suspected cofactors like psychosomatic factors, pelvic congestion, or pelvic floor dysfunction.
mod_finding: No significant differences were found in delivery mode between women with and without CPPS.
cross-section timing: Data was collected at the time of evaluation in a gynecological pain clinic for women who had experienced lower abdominal pain for at least 6 months.
